sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Bank Association.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: My name is Julia.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: How can I help you today?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Hello, I'm looking to set up an automatic monthly transfer from my checking account to a new savings account that I just opened with you online.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: All right, we can definitely do that.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Can you please provide your full name

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Owen McDougall?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: and your checking account number?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes, it is 59437289.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, and the digits on the other side of your card,

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Which digits?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: the CVV,

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Ah, it is 444.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: and the expiration date?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I'm sorry, this is safe, right?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: We could do this over the phone.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Yes, this is a secure line.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay, the expiration date is January 31.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, perfect.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: I can confirm that that is all correct.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Let me just pull up your account.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, and you would like to set up monthly transfers from the checking account to the new savings account?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes, I would like to set them up to be biweekly on the same day as my paycheck, which comes in on the 7th and the 21st of each month.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And I would also like to set that up into the highest interest savings account that I just opened with you guys, which should be having a yield of 4 .75 % for the next three years.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Since we're going to be doing some home renovations at the end of that time span, and so I'd like to have it coming out of each paycheck automatically to make it easy for me when we come down to it.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Because, you know, that roof isn't going to pay for itself, and if the bank's willing to help out with some interest, then I'm happy to take advantage of it.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And I'd like to do that automatically so that, you know, I don't forget about it, because sometimes I forget things.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Yes, I completely understand that, sir.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Can you please confirm the savings account number for me?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, perfect.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: I have typed that in, and yeah, that is the corresponding one.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: How much would you like to transfer on these 7th and 21st dates from

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Are there any limits on the transfer amounts, Juliana?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: your account? No,

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: So between accounts, there's no limits.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: that is correct.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Alright, so since I bring in every – can you tell me how much I bring in on the 7th and the 21st?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I can't quite remember off the top of my head, and I don't want to go open my banking account, because then I have to, you know, remember my password.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And if you're there already looking at it, it might be a little bit easier if you could just help me out.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: I can definitely do that, yes.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, and these will be which line item am I looking at?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: You should be looking for payments from the business business.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay,

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: They should be happening every two weeks on the 7th and the 21st, as I mentioned previously, Juliana.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: yes, I see that.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, every two weeks on the 7th and 21st, you are receiving $3 ,000.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: $3 ,000 every two weeks, and so my rent is how much?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Take the 2, carry it, divide by 12.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I think my rent is about $1 ,300 a week.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Oh, that's not right.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: A month.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And so if it's $1 ,300 a month and I bring in $3 ,000 times 2, carry the 1, $6 ,000 a month, then let's do $1 ,287 .14 every two weeks.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, I will type that in for you on the 7th and 21st of every month.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: It will be $12 ,087 .14.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Is that correct?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: No, no, sorry.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I would not be able to transfer $12 ,000 a month, Juliana.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: That would be quite unreasonable, given my meter salary.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: yes, my apologies.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Is that correct?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I don't want to put myself over budget.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: That is completely understandable, sir.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, I have set that up for you for the 7th and 21st of every month, and I have sent you an email to confirm this change with you.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: If you can accept that, click the button in the email to accept that, then it will trigger the workflow for me.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And what email did you send this to?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: I sent this to owen .mcdougal at gmail .com.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Could you send it to owen .mcdougal .grand .sun .19 .37 at gmail .com?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Absolutely.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Would you like me to update that in your file for you?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: No, this one's just for special occasions.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Alrighty,

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: All right, I think I see it.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And you said just click the OK button?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: yes.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: All right, I have clicked it.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, just give me one second to refresh,

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: and I see that the transfers have been confirmed, and they will occur every month on the 7th and 21st.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Starting when?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Starting, starting on the 21st.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: OK, sounds good to me.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And then I'm just wondering how easy it would be to pause these transfers.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: If there is, say, an emergency, such as a big sale on cheese at the farmer's market or something like that, that I'm going to need a lot of cash on hand to do.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Would it be possible to pause these at moment's notice?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Absolutely.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: You can do so either by calling us, just like you are now, or you can do so with your online banking, either on your computer or your phone.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: There will be a tab on the side that allows you to access your automatic transfers, and you can choose to pause it for one iteration indefinitely and reactivate it as you wish.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Wonderful.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And then once I want to cancel these transactions, do I also just cancel it online or do I have to call you to figure it out, Jordana?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: You can do it any way you like, either by calling us or online on your computer or your phone.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I can call you on my computer.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Now, you can call us, or you can log in to your account on your computer or on your phone.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Oh, sorry.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I was surprised by computer.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I'd never been able to call someone on it.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And I thought maybe, you know, my grandson always tells me that there's a lot of things you can do with computers nowadays.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And he's trying to help me with all these things.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And, you know, he helped me set up the account.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And, you know, so I just I was surprised when you said something like that.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And maybe I'll ask him about it.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Maybe he can help me figure that out so I can call you call you on the desktop next time.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: That would be that would be entertaining.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Well, thank you.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Thank you very much for your help, James.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And I will I will be in touch if there's anything I need to change.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, good luck with your home renovations and the cheese sale.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Well, we didn't say there was one.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I said if there was an emergency, because, you know, they pop up every once in a while.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: You need to be prepared.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: But I appreciate the sentiment.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And I wish you well.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Thank you very much.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: You as well.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Have a great day.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: You too.
